decisions.reason: A two-component injection unit built in-house and shown on its own product page is a substantial, visible investment in the plural-component direction the firm has announced, and one year is too early to judge its results.

This second resin injection unit shares the same investment and public commitment, so dropping it after one year would write off engineering work and contradict the announced focus on customized application technology.
The automatic airless gun is part of the firm's core spray-application range and is publicly listed, so there is no reason to withdraw it this early.
The manual airless gun is a core accessory that supports equipment and spare-parts sales, and it has a dedicated page, so the firm would persist with it.
A multi-model air-assisted line is the largest visible commitment among the guns, making withdrawal unlikely while early results can still be attributed to ramp-up.
The data logger is further from the firm's mechanical core and carries more uncertainty, but it is publicly launched as part of the innovation direction, so management would give it more time.
